_comment: Run-level defaults and per-measurement limits for the yield envelopes (issue #244). target_yield 0.99 and target_ci_halfwidth 0.01 are the sizing argument in README.md 'Sample size' (N=400, zero failures -> Clopper-Pearson lower bound 0.9908; Wald half-width 0.0097 at yield 0.99). Limits are quoted from spec/target-spec.md: row 1 band 4.5-5.5 GHz, row 2 ratio >= 1.15, row 7 swing >= 0.40 V, row 3 |Kvco|_mean >= 381 MHz/V with chord nonlinearity <= 30 % of span, window coverage >= 0.9 and single-signed segments (the four DR-004 requirements), row 6 startup margin >= 3.0 (graded as the per-sample lower bound the decision rung resolves). Per-measurement entries here mirror the inline limits; the inline copy travels with the sample set, this file is the single place the run defaults live.
